\newcommand{\gmopt}[1][dflt]{\gdef\Observed{(#1)}}
\let\saved\gmopt
\expandafter\patchcmd\csname\string\gmopt\endcsname{(}{[}{\gdef\Patched{yes}}{\gdef\Patched{no}}
\immediate\write16{PATCH:success=\Patched}
\gmopt[set]
\immediate\write16{PATCH:supplied=\Observed}
\saved[alias]
\immediate\write16{PATCH:alias=\Observed}
\begingroup
\expandafter\patchcmd\csname\string\gmopt\endcsname{[}{<}{\gdef\Patched{yes}}{\gdef\Patched{no}}
\gmopt
\immediate\write16{PATCH:local=\Observed}
\endgroup
\gmopt
\immediate\write16{PATCH:restored=\Observed}
\expandafter\patchcmd\csname\string\gmopt\endcsname{MISSING}{X}{\gdef\Failed{no}}{\gdef\Failed{yes}}
\immediate\write16{PATCH:failure=\Failed}
\immediate\write16{PATCH:hidden=\expandafter\meaning\csname\string\gmopt\endcsname}
